277-1308-3129-4772-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2254-5626-7874.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five creature cards in your graveyard, and one of those creature cards has mana value 1 or less.
2254-5626-7874.description:
Cast Songs of the Damned by paying {B}.
When you cast Songs of the Damned, The Immortal Weapons triggers, giving target creature +2/+0 and menace until end of turn.
Resolve Songs of the Damned, adding {B} for each creature card in your graveyard.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When you cast Chthonian Nightmare, The Immortal Weapons triggers, giving target creature +2/+0 and menace until end of turn.
Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, triggering itself, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing The Immortal Weapons, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature card with mana value 1 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E} equal to The Immortal Weapons's mana value, sacrificing the creature you returned in step 4, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning The Immortal Weapons from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When The Immortal Weapons enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Songs of the Damned from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1594-1818-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Healer of the Pride trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Healer of the Pride trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-1818-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

394-2511-3240-6462.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2511-3240-6351-6462.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Teval triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

304-1978-7434--148.notablePrerequisites:
There are legal targets for the spell with {X} in its mana cost, if applicable.
You have enough mana to cast the spell with {X} in its mana cost reduced by {C}{C}, accounting for {X} to be 2 or greater if you wish to gain life.
304-1978-7434--148.description:
Animate Brass Infiniscope.
Activate Brass Infiniscope by tapping it, adding {C}{C} and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Brass Infiniscope.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 as desired.
Cast the spell with {X} in its mana cost, with {X} being at least 2 if you wish to gain life.
Each instance of Brass Infiniscope's delayed triggered ability triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain half X life, rounded down, for each trigger.
304-1978-7434--148.notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

710-2921-7424.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

3490-4050-6752-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-6752-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

457-1792-4404-6632.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1792-4404-6632.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to The Water Crystal.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2511-2908-4986--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Dream Stalker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dream Stalker
Repeat.
2511-2908-4986--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature except Terra

206-6575-6685.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Mesmerizing Dose.
When the Mesmerizing Dose token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Repeat from step 2 two additional times, from Esper Terra's second and third chapter abilities triggering.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2366-3499-3512-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3499-3512-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mana Flare triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1642-2615.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a higher life total than Tree of Perdition's toughness.
1642-2615.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, causing its toughness to become equal to an opponents life total, and causing that opponent to lose life equal to the difference between their life total and Tree of Perdition's toughness as the ability resolved.
At the beginning of your end step, Warlock Class triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
1642-2615.notes: If the opponent's life total was at least double Tree of Perdition's toughness as the ability resolved, they will lose the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.

222-527-6798-7060.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-6798-7060.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1402-2644-4763-4927.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

783-3678-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
783-3678-6879.description:
Play Jungle Basin.
When Jungle Basin enters, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Jungle Basin.
Resolve the Jungle Basin trigger from step 2, causing you to sacrifice it
Haru triggers, returning Jungle Basin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2573-4377-4423-6886.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
2573-4377-4423-6886.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Walk the Aeons from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons during your draw step.
Repeat.

4053-5499-6791--6.notablePrerequisites: The creature with undying does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
4053-5499-6791--6.description:
Activate the creature with undying by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the undying creature.
Repeat.

1491-4565-5268-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2837-3259-6642.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any creature that can attack this turn.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
2837-3259-6642.description:
At the beginning of combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste.
Deal combat damage using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, attach Breath of Fury to the Cat token, then untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
2837-3259-6642.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both options each loop.

1156-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Pia and Kiran Nalaar, adding {C}{C}.
When Pia and Kiran Nalaar dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Pia and Kiran Nalaar from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Pia and Kiran Nalaar enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

826-1636-2034-6243.easyPrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-1636-2034-6243.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing another nontoken creature you control to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield as a white Angel.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

586-2510-2511-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
586-2510-2511-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

4996-5755.description:
Cast Beacon of Immortality by paying {5}{W}, doubling your life total and shuffling Beacon of Immortality into your library.
Enduring Tenacity's first ability triggers, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.

1308-1651-2797-4659.description:
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Servos, untapping Retrofitter Foundry.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Retrofitter Foundry's first ability to untap it and get infinite untapped Servo tokens.

803-2178-2366-3346-5220.notablePrerequisites:
Bog Glider does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Bog Glider.
"Mercenary" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-2178-2366-3346-5220.description:
Activate Bog Glider by tapping it and sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Mortuary and Bog Glider trigger.
Resolve the Bog Glider trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Dryad Arbor on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bog Glider ability from step 1, searching your library for Dryad Arbor and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ratchet, Field Medic // Ratchet, Rescue Racer

3641-4605-5118.notablePrerequisites:
You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
Distinguished Conjurer does not have summoning sickness.
3641-4605-5118.description:
Activate Distinguised Conjurer by paying {4}{W} and tapping it, blinking Ratchet, causing it to enter the battlefield as Ratchet, Field Medic.
When Ratchet, Field Medic enters the battlefield, Preston and Distinguished Conjurer trigger.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Ratchet, Field Medic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Put the nontoken Ratchet into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Choose not to return Ratchet to the command zone from your graveyard.
When the Ratchet, Field Medic token enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
The Ratchet, Field Medic token triggers, causing you to convert it into Ratchet, Rescue Racer, and return Ratchet from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Ratchet, Field Medic enters the battlefield, Preston and Distinguished Conjurer trigger.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Ratchet, Field Medic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Put the nontoken Ratchet into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Choose not to return Ratchet to the command zone from your graveyard.
The Ratchet, Rescue Racer token triggers, as well as Distinguished Conjurer.
Resolve the Ratchet, Rescue Racer trigger, causing you to convert it into Ratchet, Field Medic.
Put one of the Ratchet, Field Medic tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Resolve the Distinguished Conjurer trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 7.

1580-1785-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Soldevi Adnate.
Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
1580-1785-2178.description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}{B}.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Soldevi Adnate triggers, untapping Soldevi Adnate.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

238-2281-4050.description:
Activate Saffi Erikdotter by sacrificing itself, making it so the next time Gerrard dies this turn it will be returned to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gerrard, adding one mana of any color.
Saffi Eriksdotter and Gerrard triggers.
Resolve the Saffi Eriksdotter trigger, returning Gerrard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gerrard trigger, returning all artifact and creature cards that were put into your graveyard this turn from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

152-2034-4840.description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere.
When it ETBs, create 4 Myr tokens.
Sacrifice the tokens to Ashnod's Altar, getting eight {C}.
Use {7} to activate Cogwork Assembler's ability, creating a toekn copy of Myr Battlesphere with haste and creating 4 more tokens on ETB.
Repeat for infinite Myr tokens, colorless mana and Myr Battlespheres with haste.
